query.text: 请帮我留意患者的状态，持续不适且尚未得到及时处理时通知我；患者或照护者已及时处理、情况受控时，不必重复提醒。
query.text_en: Please monitor the patient and notify me of persistent distress that has not been promptly addressed. When the patient or caregiver has acted promptly and the situation is under control, do not repeat the alert.

annotation.text_zh: 患者持续明显喘气，未见有效处理，请及时查看并提供帮助。
annotation.text_en: The patient is still visibly gasping and no effective response has been observed. Please check on the patient promptly and provide help.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
